caption: The plug of a television is pulled while a programme is playing, and the screen goes black.

sa.check: Its plug is pulled from the socket.
The picture is moving before the pull.
The order is playing, pull, black.

pc.expect: The screen goes black at the moment the plug leaves the socket, and only then; any standby light goes off with it.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the picture still plays; or the screen goes black before the plug moves; or the screen goes black with the plug still seated and untouched; or the standby light stays lit with the plug out.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the screen stays black for the rest of the clip while the plug is out.
pc.fail: The picture comes back while the plug is out; or the screen flickers between picture and black; or a logo or menu appears on the unplugged screen; or the screen dims slowly rather than going black.

pc.expect: The screen's glow on the wall and shelf disappears with the picture.
pc.fail: The screen is black while its glow still lies on the wall; or the room brightens as the screen goes black; or the glow remains around the screen's edges.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops once the plug is free and stays attached at both ends.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or the cord floats.

pc.expect: One television, one cord, one plug, one socket; the plug leaves the socket whole; nothing passes through the wall.
pc.fail: The plug vanishes or a second plug appears; or the plug passes through the wall; or the cord splits or detaches; or the television changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The television's frame, the stand and the room stay the same apart from the screen.
pc.fail: The frame changes colour; or the stand changes; or the room's contents rearrange.

note: The sound stopping is not judged.
